text:
The kid explains that there are
two gangs of children and teens
at war in the city: the Witch
Children, who use black magic,
and the Halloween Gang who
used to bully the witch children
until they were scared off by
their magic. Then he leaves.

zh-CN.title: 39 - 孩子讲述故事
text: 孩子解释说，城里有两群交战中的孩子帮派：使用黑魔法的女巫孩子帮，以及过去霸凌女巫孩子、后来被他们的魔法吓跑的万圣节帮派。说完，他便离开。
